text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives message from Palestinian President Yasser Arafat concerning bilateral ties.
- Two ships with wheat and salt bought under the oil-for- food deal with the United Nations dock at Um Qasr in southern Iraq.
- Iraq protests to the Arab League against British and U.S. warplanes' violation of Iraqi space.
(The above were also carried by IRAQ)
- Health Minister Umed Madhat Mubarak meets deputy chairman of Syrian medical industries.
